skill.name: ai-music
skill.description: Generate and edit music with the RunComfy CLI. The skill selects ElevenLabs Music or ACE Step routes, then prepares model inputs for new tracks, inpaint edits, and outpaint extensions.
skill.summary: Route music generation and editing requests to the right RunComfy model.
skill.author: runcomfy-com

security_audit.summary: Static findings were false positives from Markdown code formatting, documented CLI examples, public links, placeholder audio URLs, and disclosed token storage. No prompt injection attempt, covert exfiltration, or malicious intent was found in SKILL.md. Users should still understand that RunComfy commands contact external model services and can incur usage costs.

remediation.issue: Markdown command examples trigger external-command scanner noise.
remediation.suggestion: Keep commands clearly labeled as examples and keep allowed tools scoped to RunComfy commands.

remediation.issue: RunComfy requests send prompts, lyrics, and audio URLs to external model services.
remediation.suggestion: Ask users before submitting sensitive content and keep the documented endpoint allowlist current.

remediation.issue: CLI authentication stores a token under the user config directory.
remediation.suggestion: Continue documenting file permissions and recommend RUNCOMFY_TOKEN for CI or container workflows.

content.value_statement: Music projects need fast drafts, edits, and model choices without manual API work. This skill routes requests to RunComfy music models and prepares the CLI command.
actual_capabilities: Selects ElevenLabs Music, ACE Step, ACE Step 1.5, audio-inpaint, or audio-outpaint based on intent.
Prepares RunComfy CLI invocations with model IDs and structured input fields.
Compares premium, cost-sensitive, multilingual, vocal, and instrumental generation routes.
Guides time-bounded audio inpaint edits for existing tracks.
Guides bidirectional outpaint extensions for intros, outros, and longer arrangements.
limitations: Requires the RunComfy CLI and an authenticated RunComfy account or token.
Sends prompts, lyrics, and provided audio URLs to RunComfy model services.
May incur usage costs based on the selected model and duration.
Does not verify lyric rights, copyright ownership, or commercial licensing claims.

use_cases.title: Draft Background Tracks
use_cases.description: Create low-cost instrumental loops and music beds for prototypes or content libraries.

use_cases.title: Create Campaign Jingles
use_cases.description: Route premium vocal briefs to ElevenLabs Music for polished brand audio.

use_cases.title: Repair Existing Songs
use_cases.description: Use ACE Step inpaint or outpaint to replace sections or extend a short hook.

prompt_templates.title: Generate an Instrumental Draft
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a simple music bed.
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a 60 second instrumental track for [project]. Prefer a low-cost model. Return the RunComfy command and model choice.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Vocal Song
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request with lyrics and style direction.
prompt_templates.prompt: Make a vocal song in [style] with these lyrics: [lyrics]. Choose the best RunComfy music route for quality and cost.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Multilingual Launch
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for several language versions.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create the same song in [languages]. Keep the arrangement consistent. Recommend the model, inputs, and cost strategy.

prompt_templates.title: Edit an Existing Track
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request using audio inpaint or outpaint.
prompt_templates.prompt: Edit this audio URL: [url]. Replace or extend [time range]. Choose inpaint or outpaint and prepare the RunComfy command.

output_examples.input: I need a low-cost 60 second game loop.
output_examples.output: The skill selects ACE Step base, suggests loop-focused tags, estimates cost, and prepares a RunComfy invocation.

output_examples.input: Make a polished 15 second campaign jingle with vocals.
output_examples.output: The skill routes the request to ElevenLabs Music and structures the brief with sections, lyrics, and duration.

output_examples.input: Extend my 30 second hook into a two minute track.
output_examples.output: The skill selects ACE Step audio-outpaint and describes how to add intro and outro material around the source audio.

best_practices: Start with short drafts before generating long final tracks.
Use ACE Step base for large batches and ElevenLabs Music for premium vocal output.
Provide only audio URLs that the user owns or has permission to process.
anti_patterns: Do not paste API tokens, secrets, or private lyrics into prompts.
Do not use copyrighted lyrics unless the user confirms rights.
Do not send unknown third-party audio URLs without user approval.

faq.question: What does this skill generate?
faq.answer: It helps generate songs, instrumentals, jingles, loops, and edited music through RunComfy models.

faq.question: Which models does it use?
faq.answer: It routes to ElevenLabs Music, ACE Step, ACE Step 1.5, ACE Step inpaint, or ACE Step outpaint.

faq.question: Does it require a RunComfy account?
faq.answer: Yes. The RunComfy CLI must be installed and authenticated before model runs can complete.

faq.question: Can it edit existing audio?
faq.answer: Yes. It can guide time-range replacement with inpaint or track extension with outpaint.

faq.question: Can it make multilingual vocals?
faq.answer: Yes. ACE Step 1.5 is documented for broad multilingual vocal support.

faq.question: Does it check copyright permissions?
faq.answer: No. Users must confirm rights for lyrics, source audio, and commercial use.
